name: cocos-creator
description: Develop Cocos Creator projects and build Web or mini-game artifacts with the local editor.

interface.shortDescription: Develop Cocos games and build platform artifacts.
interface.longDescription: Edit TypeScript, scenes, and assets with a local Cocos Creator installation and build Web, WeChat, or Douyin output. Targets Creator 3.8 LTS and keeps each project's editor version. Enable a platform plugin for mini-game packaging and device checks.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Cocos Creator project's version and build setup.
Implement a tap counter in this Cocos project and build a local preview.
